What We Coat for Mississauga Businesses

We coat steel and aluminum parts for Mississauga customers, from small brackets to heavy welded frames. Each piece is cleaned, pretreated, sprayed with thermoset powder and cured in our oven, so you get a finish that lasts through hard daily use.

For powder coating Mississauga manufacturers and fabricators build into production, we handle conveyor frames, machine guards, bollards, railings, trailer parts, enclosures and shelving. Electrostatic spray lays down an even coat that wraps edges and corners, and chemical pretreatment helps the powder bond and supports corrosion resistance. The result is a chip-resistant finish that, with the right powder, holds its colour outdoors.

Our curing oven supports parts up to 6,000 lb, so large part work fits as easily as small batches. Steel parts and aluminum parts can run side by side, and we confirm the powder and colour with you before spraying. Mississauga powder coating projects range from one-off parts to full production runs.

Services Available to Mississauga Customers

Mississauga customers can book sandblasting, surface preparation, custom colours, restoration and bulk production runs. Mobile sandblasting is also offered, so ask us if a part cannot easily travel. Abrasive blasting removes rust and old coatings, then pretreatment prepares the metal. Powder Coating Mississauga FAQs

These answers cover common questions about pickup, timing, quotes, large parts and order size for Mississauga customers. If your question is not here, call (905) 876-7060 during business hours and we will help.

blocks.q: Do you offer pickup and delivery for powder coating in Mississauga?
blocks.a: Yes, pickup and delivery is available. Tell us your location, part sizes and quantity when you request a quote, and we will confirm whether it suits your order. You can also drop parts at our Milton shop Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM.

blocks.q: How long does Mississauga powder coating take?
blocks.a: We work to a 48 hour turnaround. Heavy rust removal, large parts or high volume can affect timing, so we confirm the schedule with you when you send photos and quantities for your quote.

blocks.q: What should I send to get a quote?
blocks.a: Send photos of the parts, approximate size, metal type, quantity and the colour or finish you want. Include a RAL code if you have one. Photos of rust, old paint or threaded holes help us plan prep and masking before we quote.

blocks.q: Can you coat large or heavy parts?
blocks.a: Yes. Our oven handles parts up to 6,000 lb, and mobile sandblasting is offered for work that is hard to move. Send dimensions and weight so we can confirm the fit before you travel.

blocks.q: Do you take small orders as well as bulk orders?
blocks.a: Yes. We coat one-off parts and prototypes as well as recurring production runs. Every order follows the same prep, coating and curing steps, so a single bracket gets the same care as a full batch.

blocks.q: Where do I drop off parts for powder coating Mississauga orders?
blocks.a: Bring parts to 10874 Steeles Ave E, Milton, ON L9T 2X8, Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM. Call (905) 876-7060 first so we can confirm timing. Mississauga powder coating drop-offs are quickest when parts are labelled and a finish is chosen.
